motion.name: Hanes GEO Site Quantity Analysis

supportedDeterministicClaims: Equivalent fixture inputs produce equivalent computed quantity outputs.

Read-only presentation behavior in the review package.
limitationsAndNonClaims: No claim of connected parser execution in a live customer tenant.
No claim that automation flow is enabled.
No claim that target import conditions are universally clean-ready.
No claim of completed Dynamics browser acceptance walkthrough.
reviewChecklist: Confirm package contains only customer-viewable, public-safe content.
